posts.caption:
The deck wraps nearly all the way around.

At 10707 47th St E in Edgewood, the mountain view comes along for summer barbecues, parties and morning coffee. Inside: three bedrooms, three baths and 2,572 square feet over three levels, with a primary suite that has a view of its own.

The lower level is fully finished, with a rec room, a three-quarter bath, a guest room and its own door outside. The lot is a park-like 0.31-acre corner on a dead-end street, with terraced landscaping, sprinklers, RV parking, a large shed and generator wiring.

Want to see it in person? Send me a message and I’ll set up a private showing. Every photo is at homes.ranchpnw.com/10707.

Chris Ranch · The Ranch Real Estate Group · (253) 335-5630
